subject.title: feat: Cron job tags/categories for organization and filtering

question: Should cron job organization use freeform user tags, a typed purpose/display metadata contract, or remain limited to plugin-local name prefixes for scheduled-turn cleanup?
rationale: The requested feature changes a durable cron job API/storage/UI contract and overlaps with reminders and plugin scheduling, so automation should not choose the permanent model alone.

options.title: Typed purpose/display metadata
options.body: Add a narrow first-party classification/display contract that can support reminders, general job organization, API filters, and UI rendering without relying on name parsing.

options.title: Freeform tags
options.body: Implement the requested optional string-array tags directly, accepting a broader user taxonomy surface that may need later typed fields for reminders.

options.title: Keep plugin-local prefixes
options.body: Leave core unchanged for now and continue using name conventions only for plugin-owned scheduled-turn cleanup, deferring user-visible organization.

recommendation.title: Typed purpose/display metadata
recommendation.body: Add a narrow first-party classification/display contract that can support reminders, general job organization, API filters, and UI rendering without relying on name parsing.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the clearest maintainer signal on the related cron metadata/API direction and has adjacent compact-list protocol history.
